data.name: SUMOWBALL
data.detailed_description:
SUMOWBALL

Roll bigger. Hit harder. Stay on the island.

Every match begins the same.

Tiny snowballs.

A snowy island.

A group of penguins with the exact same goal.

Roll across the snow to grow your snowball. The larger it becomes, the harder you hit—but the harder it is to control. Every decision is a balance between power, speed, and maneuverability.

There are no weapons.

There are no abilities.

There are no health bars.

Only physics, momentum, and the edge of the island.

Master the Snowball

Your snowball is everything.

It isn't a vehicle. It isn't equipment.

It is your movement, your weapon, and your greatest weakness.

Movement comes from real rolling physics. Snow naturally makes your snowball grow, while ice takes away your grip. Every collision is determined by momentum and closing speed, rewarding timing and positioning instead of arbitrary damage values.

Grow too small and you'll struggle to push anyone.

Grow too large and you may not turn fast enough to survive.

Finding the perfect balance is what separates the winners from everyone else.

Only One Penguin Wins

The island won't save you forever.

As the match progresses, the arena slowly collapses into the sea, forcing every surviving penguin into increasingly chaotic encounters.

Space disappears.

Escapes become impossible.

Eventually, someone has to fall.

Be the last penguin standing.

Play Together

Jump into public matches, create private lobbies with passwords, or challenge friends over LAN.

SUMOWBALL supports up to 20 players, with empty slots automatically filled by AI bots that actively grow, survive, and hunt opponents using multiple skill levels.

If someone disconnects, they can rejoin the match.

If the host leaves, automatic host migration keeps the game going.

Customize Every Match

Every arena can be tailored to your playstyle.

  • Choose between four arena sizes
    Adjust snow growth speed
    Set or remove the maximum snowball size
    Control ice coverage
    Add hills and terrain variation
    Place obstacles and decorative props
    Choose when the island begins shrinking
    Adjust the final playable area

Every change updates the arena in real time before the match begins.

Designed to Be Read

A world made of snow shouldn't make gameplay difficult.

Optional accessibility features help keep the action clear without changing the core experience.

  • Player outlines
    Island edge indicators
    Gameplay hints
    Each option can be enabled or disabled independently

Key Features

  • Physics-based multiplayer party game
    Real rolling physics
    Momentum-based collisions
    Grow your snowball by rolling
    Bigger snowballs hit harder—but become harder to control
    Dynamic shrinking island
    Supports up to 20 players
    Online and LAN multiplayer
    Public and private lobbies
    AI bots with multiple skill levels
    Reconnect support
    Automatic host migration
    Extensive match customization
    Fast-paced matches with endless replayability

Roll bigger.

Hit harder.

Stay on the island.

Become the last penguin standing.

data.short_description: Roll, grow, and knock your opponents off the island in this physics-based multiplayer party game. Master momentum, build the biggest snowball, and be the last penguin standing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 / NVIDIA GT 1030 (2 GB VRAM, DirectX 11 / OpenGL 4.1 support)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
